title: Operations analyst - vaga exclusiva para pcd
description:
Confira a vaga para Operations analyst - vaga exclusiva para pcd em são paulo. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Se para você a tecnologia existe para melhorar o caminho da vida, para o nosso time também: Seu Caminho, Nossa Jornada.  Acreditamos na tecnologia que conecta gente boa no que faz e que vive a diversidade para criar e compartilhar até os caminhos que a gente (ainda!) nem sabe quais são. Trabalhamos para gerar valor não só para os nossos usuários, mas, sobretudo, para as comunidades que servimos e toda a sociedade, tornando a vida das pessoas melhor com serviços que facilitem seu dia a dia - seja com serviços de mobilidade e entrega (99) ou pagamentos digitais (99 Pay).  Para facilitar a vida de milhões de pessoas todos os dias, desde 2018 fazemos parte da Di Di Global Inc., a maior plataforma de tecnologia e transporte por aplicativo do mundo. Somos pioneiros na criação de soluções inovadoras que começam no Brasil e que ganham escala para gerar impacto positivo em mais de 12 países em que a Di Di está presente. Essas inovações passam por sustentabilidade, segurança, inteligência artificial, mercado financeiro e um tanto mais.  Seja para construir projetos do zero ou aprimorar nossas soluções, gostamos de desafios que nos fazem sentir frio na barriga, e é por isso que trabalhamos num ritmo acelerado, com respeito, colaboração e bom humor. Nessa jornada, também nos fortalecemos nas diferentes vivências e opiniões para crescermos juntos, errar rápido, aprender e ajustar o caminho para criar soluções que tragam ainda melhores resultados.  Estamos buscando uma Analista com forte viés analítico e visão de negócios para integrar nosso time de Estratégia e Operações.  Esta posição atua de forma transversal, conectando inteligência de dados com a realidade do mercado para suportar a tomada de decisão da liderança.  Se você gosta de resolver problemas complexos, tem facilidade em navegar por grandes volumes de dados e busca impactar diretamente a eficiência e a competitividade do negócio em escala nacional, este é o seu lugar.  Suas responsabilidades serão:  Análise de Performance:  Monitorar os principais KPIs do negócio, identificando tendências, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria na operação.  Suporte Estratégico:  Fornecer insumos analíticos e cenários para apoiar o planejamento de projetos e a alocação eficiente de recursos.  Interface Cross-Funcional:  Atuar como ponto de contato entre as áreas de Dados, Finanças e Operações, garantindo o alinhamento das iniciativas e o fluxo correto de informações.  Melhoria Contínua:  Mapear gargalos operacionais e propor planos de ação baseados em dados para otimizar nossos processos e resultados.  Reporting:  Elaborar materiais executivos e dashboards que deem visibilidade clara sobre o andamento das iniciativas para os stakeholders.    São requisitos:  Pensamento Analítico:  Capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos e transformar dados brutos em insights de negócio acionáveis.  Ferramentas de Dados:  Domínio de Excel/Google Sheets e conhecimentos em SQL (será utilizado para extração e manipulação de bases).  Visão Sistêmica:  Consegue enxergar o "todo" e entender como uma mudança em uma ponta impacta o restante da cadeia de valor.  Comunicação:  Habilidade para sintetizar informações complexas de forma simples e direta para diferentes níveis hierárquicos.  Adaptabilidade:  Conforto em trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, com prioridades que evoluem conforme a necessidade do mercado.    Na 99...  Geramos Valor para os Usuários - Existimos para fazer o melhor para os nossos usuários e inovamos para estarmos sempre na frente. Buscamos o equilíbrio entre experiência, eficiência e crescimento, tendo a segurança sempre em primeiro lugar.  Somos Guiados por Dados - Acreditamos na tomada de decisão guiada por dados. Através dos números, navegamos em nosso negócio de forma estratégica.  Somos Donos e Focados nos Resultados - Vamos além dos interesses pessoais para focar no que é melhor para a Di Di. Sempre cumprimos o que prometemos e buscamos a excelência na execução, estabelecendo uma barra alta e dando o nosso máximo em tudo que fazemos.  Sempre Construímos Juntos - Juntos somos mais fortes. Temos a mente aberta e sempre remamos com respeito, empatia e confiança uns nos outros. Ouvimos a opinião de todos antes de tomar uma decisão e, quando decidimos algo, cumprimos o combinado juntos, mesmo se discordarmos.  Somos Íntegros - Integridade é a nossa base e a linha que nunca ultrapassamos. Comunicamos com honestidade, transparência e ouvimos a voz de todos para sempre fazer o que é certo.  Desenvolvemos uns aos Outros - Nosso crescimento vem da constante aventura de estarmos fora da nossa zona de conforto. Aceitamos desafios, nos superamos e trabalhamos em busca da excelência em tudo que fazemos. Desde o primeiro dia, nos desenvolvemos e ajudamos as pessoas ao nosso redor a crescerem também, elevando a nossa barra.  Trabalhamos com Paixão & Diversão - Somos completamente apaixonados pelo que fazemos. Mantemos um espírito leve e otimista, contagiando o nosso ambiente com energia positiva. Somos resilientes, não temos medo de enfrentar desafios e sempre celebramos nosso sucesso.  Vivemos a Diversidade - Para nós, o coração da diversidade é a inclusão, a igualdade e o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove um ambiente mais criativo e cheio de energia, por isso, celebramos as diferenças e aqui todos podem ser quem são.   Diversidade e Inclusão    Diversidade não é uma visão de futuro ou desejo de algo que queremos um dia, é um valor inegociável de quem somos hoje.  Vivemos a inclusão, a pluralidade e o respeito e, para isso, contamos com a governança do Comitê de Diversidade que atua junto com o RH, a nossa liderança e os grupos de identidade - 99 Adapta, 99 Afro, 99 Cores, 99 Mulheres e 99 Famílias.  Essa é a nossa jornada já escrita que ainda tem muito caminho para percorrer.  Reconheço que, antes de enviar esta inscrição, li e aceitei o Aviso de Privacidade para Candidatos, disponível em

description:

Engenheiro de Dados     O Chaves na Mão é um dos principais portais de classificados de imóveis e veículos do Brasil. Trabalhamos com grandes volumes de dados e buscamos transformá-los em insights estratégicos para aprimorar a experiência do usuário, otimizar processos e impulsionar nossos resultados.  Estamos procurando um Engenheiro de Dados para estruturar, otimizar e escalar nossa arquitetura de dados, garantindo eficiência, confiabilidade e governança. Principais Atividades     Arquitetura e Pipelines de Dados   ● Projetar e desenvolver pipelines escaláveis e eficientes para ingestão, processamento e análise de dados na AWS.  ● Criar e otimizar ETLs usando AWS Glue, Redshift, Lambda, S3 e Athena garantindo integração fluida entre diferentes fontes de dados.  ● Utilizar ferramentas de orquestração e automação como Apache Airflow  ● Gerenciar Data Warehouses e Data Lakes para atender às necessidades de análise e BI.  ● Implementar estratégias de particionamento, indexação e caching para otimizar a performance de consultas.  Transformação e Análise de Dados   ● Assegurar a qualidade, integridade e confiabilidade dos dados ingeridos e processados.  ● Criar e manter dashboards interativos e relatórios estratégicos no Quick Sight ou Power BI.  ● Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Engenharia, Produto, BI e Data Science para fornecer dados estruturados e acionáveis.  Integração e Governança de Dados   ● Desenvolver APIs e integrações para facilitar o consumo de dados por diferentes times e aplicações.  ● Estabelecer processos de Data Governance, garantindo conformidade com LGPD e GDPR.  ● Criar documentação técnica e boas práticas para a equipe e stakeholders internos.  Requisitos     Formação e Experiência   ● Formação em Engenharia de Software, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados ou áreas correlatas.  ● Experiência comprovada em arquitetura e engenharia de dados, incluindo armazenamento, processamento e otimização de dados em grande escala.  ● Conhecimento sólido e experiência prática em AWS, especialmente em Redshift e Glue (ETL/Data Catalog).  ● Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e No SQL (My SQL, Dynamo DB, Mongo DB Redis, Elasticsearch).  ● Experiência em pipelines de dados e orquestração (Apache Airflow).  ● Sólidos conhecimentos em ETL, ELT e transformação de dados.  ● Domínio de SQL e Python, com experiência em manipulação e transformação de dados.  ● Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados como Amazon Quick Sight, Power BI ou Tableau.  ● Familiaridade com Docker e serviços de contêineres.  ● Experiência em infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Pulumi).  Diferenciais   ● Experiência com Kinesis, Athena, S3 e Lambda para pipelines de dados serverless.  ● Conhecimento em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e mensageria (Rabbit MQ, SQS).  ● Experiência com Data Governance e compliance (LGPD, GDPR).  ● Familiaridade com CI/CD para pipelines de dados.  O que oferecemos   Remuneração compatível com o mercado  Plano de saúde Unimed Individual com Co-participação;   Plano Odontológico Bradesco;   Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);   Prêmio por assiduidade;   Total Pass; Programa de Benefícios SESC;   Vale-Refeição: R$ 28,00 reais por dia (Flash);   Vale Transporte: R$ 12,00 reais por dia;   Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;   Expediente: segunda à sexta-feira das 08:30 às 17:30  Atuação 100% presencial - Centro de Curitiba     Vem para o Chaves na Mão e nos ajude a conquistar o futuro extraordinário e inevitável: ser o #1 do Brasil no mercado de anúncios!

description:

O Agente de Registro é o profissional responsável por atuar no processo de emissão de certificados digitais, garantindo a validação, segurança e conformidade dos procedimentos exigidos pela legislação e pelas entidades certificadoras. Sua função principal é verificar a autenticidade dos documentos apresentados, realizar atendimentos presenciais ou remotos, além de coletar dados biométricos e emitir o certificado digital.  Descrição de Cargo:   Realizar atendimento presencial ao cliente na unidade da instituição, com data e hora previamente agendadas, garantindo um serviço personalizado e eficiente.  Realizar atendimento remoto via videoconferência, assegurando a mesma qualidade de suporte oferecida no atendimento presencial.  Realizar atendimento in loco, quando necessário, deslocando-se até o local do cliente para oferecer suporte presencial, conforme a demanda e necessidade do cliente.  Tirar dúvidas e prestar orientações detalhadas sobre a usabilidade do certificado digital, proporcionando uma experiência de uso clara e facilitada.  Realizar a conferência e verificar a autenticidade e veracidade dos documentos apresentados, assegurando que estejam em conformidade com as exigências legais e regulamentares.  Lançar os dados do cliente no sistema interno, garantindo que todas as informações estejam corretas e devidamente registradas, seguindo os padrões de segurança e confidencialidade.  Coletar a biometria facial e digital do cliente de forma online, utilizando ferramentas tecnológicas que assegurem a precisão e segurança dos dados biométricos.  Realizar a emissão do certificado digital, garantindo que todos os procedimentos tenham sido devidamente cumpridos, e que o cliente receba o certificado de forma rápida e segura.  Orientar o cliente sobre o processo de download (baixa) do certificado digital, explicando sua importância, prazos de validade, e as melhores práticas para mantê-lo seguro e acessível.  Realizar o atendimento e fornecer suporte contínuo aos clientes e contadores, utilizando todos os meios de comunicação oferecidos pela empresa, como telefone, e-mail, chat ou outros, garantindo a solução de dúvidas e problemas relacionados ao certificado digital  Viajar ocasionalmente para treinar novos colaboradores, compartilhar boas práticas e padrões operacionais, ou ate mesmo para cobrir férias e ausências em diferentes unidades ou na sede da instituição, conforme a necessidade de alocação. Sendo que esta alocação é diferente da sua alocação rotineira.     Salário:   R$ 2.043,39   Benefícios:   * Vale alimentação/refeição de R$ 28,00 ao dia;   * Vale Saúde no valor de R$ 320,00 no mês;   * Plano Odontológico Dental Uni Elite;   * Convênio com farmácia;   * Gympass;  * Subsídio dê duas sessões de psicoterapia no espaço Existir;   * Convênio com instituições de ensino;   * Campanhas de comemoração para os colaboradores.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Empresa está contratando Cientista de dados em barueri. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Estamos em busca de um Cientista de Dados Sênior  para fortalecer a agenda de inteligência e analytics avançado na Vertem.  Essa posição terá papel estratégico na construção e operacionalização de modelos de Machine Learning  aplicados a problemas reais de negócio, utilizando uma arquitetura moderna de dados baseada em Databricks  em ambiente AWS  .  O profissional atuará diretamente no desenvolvimento, treinamento, implantação e monitoramento de modelos preditivos, contribuindo para transformar dados em soluções inteligentes que apoiem decisões estratégicas, produtos analíticos e geração de valor para clientes e parceiros.  Buscamos alguém com forte capacidade analítica, domínio técnico em ciência de dados e experiência prática em ambientes modernos de dados e inteligência artificial.  Responsabilidades e atribuições   O Cientista de Dados Sênior será responsável por desenvolver soluções analíticas avançadas e modelos de machine learning que contribuam diretamente para a geração de valor para o negócio.  Entre as principais responsabilidades estão:  Desenvolver, treinar e validar modelos de Machine Learning  aplicados a problemas reais de negócio.  Trabalhar com grandes volumes de dados armazenados no Data Lake corporativo em AWS  .  Utilizar o ecossistema da plataforma Databricks  para experimentação, treinamento e operacionalização de modelos.  Construir pipelines de dados e pipelines de treinamento de modelos.  Utilizar recursos de Auto ML do Databricks  para acelerar experimentação e geração de modelos.  Realizar feature engineering  e preparação de dados para modelos analíticos.  Implementar e manter rotinas de deploy e scoring de modelos de machine learning em produção  .  Monitorar performance de modelos, avaliando possíveis degradações e necessidade de re-treinamento.  Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia de dados, BI e produtos de dados  para transformar dados em soluções analíticas escaláveis.  Apoiar a evolução da plataforma de inteligência da empresa, contribuindo com boas práticas de ciência de dados e machine learning.     Esperamos que a pessoa tenha experiência sólida em ciência de dados aplicada a ambientes corporativos e plataformas modernas de dados.  Entre os conhecimentos e experiências desejados estão:   Requisitos e qualificações   Experiência técnica  Vivência com Databricks  .  Vivência em desenvolvimento de modelos de machine learning supervisionados e não supervisionados  .  Conhecimento em Auto ML no Databricks  .  Vivência em deploy de modelos de machine learning em produção  .  Conhecimento em scoring de modelos e pipelines de inferência  .  Vivência com feature engineering  e preparação de dados para modelos analíticos.  Domínio de Python aplicado à ciência de dados  .  Vivência com bibliotecas como:  scikit-learn  XGBoost  Light GBM  Ter atuado com dados em ambientes de Data Lake e Big Data  .   Diferenciais:   Vivência com MLflow  .  Vivência com monitoramento e governança de modelos de machine learning.  Atuação em projetos de recomendação, segmentação ou modelos de propensão  .  Vivência em ambientes de dados em AWS  .  Vivência em projetos de analytics avançado e produtos de dados    Informações adicionais   ✨ O que temos para te oferecer?  ✨  Para equilibrar trabalho e vida pessoal:    Flex Office – 2 dias de home office e 3 dias presenciais.  Day Off no aniversário – Seu dia especial, do jeito que preferir!  ⏰ Horário flexível – Mais autonomia para organizar sua rotina.  Para cuidar da sua saúde e bem-estar:

title: Planejador operações
description:
Confira a vaga para Planejador operações em medianeira. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Planejador de Vendas e de Operações (S&OP)     Principais responsabilidades:   Construir processo de planejamento de vendas de médio e longo prazo;   Construir processo de planejamento de produção de médio e longo prazo;   Organizar etapas do processo de S&OP com modelo de governança em cada uma das etapas, estruturando calendário corporativo de atividades das áreas participantes;   Estruturar modelos de análise de atendimento dos planos da Demanda Irrestrita, construindo cenários da demanda não atendida, formando a Demanda Restrita;   Apresentar a estratificação dos resultados não atendidos ou cenários de risco de não atendimento;   Elaborar “tradeoffs” de possibilidades de mitigação dos volumes não atendidos, desdobrando planos de ação com as áreas de interface para tratamento de desvios e planos de ação;   Elaborar materiais de apresentação dos resultados de cada rodada de S&OP, para Fóruns oficiais executivos e fóruns intermediários de operação e alinhamento entre as áreas de interface;   Conciliar o plano irrestrito e restrito com o plano financeiro, identificando gaps de receita bruta e margem de contribuição decorrentes das decisões de mix de produtos, mercados e/ou restrições de produção;   Monitorar o impacto de lançamentos e descontinuações no plano de demanda e operações, garantindo o escoamento de itens obsoletos ou de baixo giro;   Liderar a análise de causa raiz para desvios críticos de acuracidade de demanda e cumprimento do plano de produção, implementando planos de ação para redução do viés e melhoria do nível de serviço;   Desenvolver ou apoiar na construção modelos de simulação para avaliar o impacto de grandes variações de mercado, disponibilidade de matéria prima e/ou investimentos em capacidade produtiva, apoiando a tomada de decisão executiva.     Pré-requisitos:   Experiência em áreas de planejamento de operações (Supply Chain);   Experiência em processo S&OP;   Conhecimento avançado em Excel ou Power BI;   Conhecimento emplanejamento de produção (MPS);   Conhecimento emplanejamento de materiais (MRP);   Vivência em ambientes de gestão e controle avançado de indicadores de performance de vendas e atendimento;   Conhecimento degestão de indicadores de nível de serviço e custos de estoque;   Noções de planejamento de abastecimento e estoques de segurança;   Experiência em gestão de estoque e shelf Life.

title: Especialista em estoque
description:
Confira a vaga para Especialista em estoque em medianeira. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Especialista em Gestão de Estoques e Perdas     Principais Responsabilidades:    - gerenciar níveis de estoque versus políticas de estoques;   - gerenciar qualidade de shelf Life dos estoques, desdobrando planos de ação e implantando processos e controles;   - elaborar políticas de estoque de segurança e ciclo, com ajustes periódicos de acordo com efetividade e aderência das políticas;   - personalizar parâmetros de políticas de estoques por fábrica e por CD;   - elaborar e implantar modelos de abastecimento de estoques por CD;   - gerenciar as contas de perdas de produtos acabados e materiais diretos da indústria  - desdobrar planos de ação com os responsáveis pelas contas de perdas para buscar otimização e ganhos;   - elaborar painéis de indicadores chave e itens de controle meio dos indicadores financeiros de estoque - Fluxo de Caixa, NCG - Estoques, NCG Fornecedores, Giro, Cobertura e Qualidade;   - gerenciar ocupação de armazéns e centros de distribuição;   - gerenciar tamanhos de lotes de produção e compras;   - organizar e preparar reuniões de desdobramento e apresentação de resultados;   - elaborar processo de simulações de custos derivados do estoque e trade off versus níveis de serviço e receita protegida (custos de capital empregado, obsolescência e perdas, custos logísticos versus receita).  Principais Atividades:    - planejamento Estratégico de indicadores de performance e interface com área financeira;   - controles de Níveis e Qualidade de Estoques:  >   NCG/   Cobertura (futuro)  >       Capex  - gestão de Perdas: motivos comerciais/motivos de operações (qualidade, logística, industrial, compras e planejamento):  >  Perdas de materiais diretos e materiais indiretos: embalagens, matérias primas e semi elaborados  - gestão de níveis atuais e projeções futuras de estoques e perdas por: Categoria, Marca e SKU/Por Fábrica e CD versus políticas de estoques ideais/Por produto acabado, insumo e semi elaborado  - análise da relação causa e efeito dos desvios de falta e excessos/desdobramento de planos de ação e acompanhamento;   - painel de alertas dos desvios/desdobramento e estudo de causas, envolvendo interfaces e analisando dados e relatórios;   - liderança de Fóruns de Estoques e Construção de cenários para Fóruns Oficiais Resultados:  >  Reuniões de fechamento mensal e acompanhamento semanal da Empresa  >   Fóruns customizados para as áreas Comerciais e de Operações  - desenho de metodologias e implantação de Políticas de estoque de segurança, de ciclo, de trânsito e políticas especiais;   - construção de Painéis de Indicadores (Corporativos e de Áreas);   - gestão avançadade shelf life de Produto: gerenciar múltiplas visões de qualidade de estoque com dados históricos e projeções.  Pré requisitos:    - mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em áreas de Supply Chain;   - experiência anterior em gestão sênior de estoques e implantação de itens de controle de estoques (NCG, Giro, Cobertura e Qualidade);   - experiência em gestão de estoque de centenas de SKU's;   - noções básicas de cadeia de abastecimento completa (planejamento de produção e  compras, distribuição, gestão de estoques e gestão de pedidos);   - experiência em gestão de perdas;   - pacote office intermediário;   - vivência com interfaces de operações industriais e logísticas (desejável);   - conhecimentos de Power BI ou Excel avançado (desejável).

description:

Sua atuação envolve o acompanhamento, análise e reporte dos resultados de contagens e movimentações de materiais, assegurando conformidade com os procedimentos internos e padrões de qualidade. Aqui possuímos uma meta ousada de crescimento profissional interno, então, se quiser trabalhar para um dos principais operadores logística do mundo, se inscreva nas nossas posições em aberto.  SUA JORNADA   Valorizamos o seu crescimento profissional e pessoal. É por isso que compartilhamos muitas oportunidades para iniciar sua jornada na CEVA. Junte-se à nós para uma carreira desafiadora.

Seguimos determinados em nossa trajetória de crescimento em energia renovável que gere competitividade ao país, novas e ampliadas oportunidades para nossos colaboradores, respeito ao meio ambiente e a saúde e segurança das nossas pessoas e parceria com as comunidades em que atuamos. Visando cumprir as normas de compliance e legislação tributária, para certificar o recebimento das notas fiscais de acordo com o a alocação de gastos em CAPEX, tributos e atender aos requisitos da ANEEL referente a modernização onde haverão desativações, ativações e alienações dos ativos já existentes e novos. Overview   The HR Services Administrator role is a fantastic opportunity to build a strong foundation in HR and develop your skills within a supportive and collaborative team environment. Acting as the first point of contact for employees and managers, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality HR support across the organisation.  You will gain hands-on experience across the full employee lifecycle, supporting a wide range of HR processes while ensuring accuracy, consistency, and a great employee experience. Working within the HR Services team, you will develop a solid understanding of HR systems, policies, and best practice, with plenty of opportunity to learn and grow. Reporting and Compliance    · Run standard HR reports and provide basic HR data or analytics to HR teams, HR Business Partners or leadership when required.  · Support HR audits and compliance activities.  · Ensure HR records are maintained in accordance with company policies, data protection requirements and employment legislation.  Collaboration and HR Service Delivery    · Work closely with HR Services Advisors to ensure efficient resolution of HR queries and cases.  · Partner with HR Business Partners and HR Centres of Excellence to support HR processes and activities.  · Ensure HR activities are delivered in line with organisational policies and standards.  · Adhere to company safety, integrity and code of conduct policies.  Continuous Improvement    · Support continuous improvement initiatives within HR Services.  · Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, service delivery and system usage.  · Contribute to maintaining efficient and consistent HR administration within the HR Services team.  Skills and Experience:   · Previous experience in an administrative, HR support or customer service role desirable.  · Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.  · Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workload effectively in a fast-paced environment.  · Strong communication skills and a professional approach when responding to HR enquiries.  · Ability to ask effective questions to understand the nature of HR enquiries and identify appropriate solutions.  · Demonstrates empathy, emotional intelligence and a strong customer service mindset when supporting employees and managers.  · Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information appropriately.  · Comfortable working with HR systems and technology.  Knowledge and Qualifications:   · Experience working in an HR environment desirable.  · Working knowledge of HR systems such as Workday desirable.  · Basic understanding of HR policies, HR processes and employment law fundamentals.  · Education in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field  Additional Requirements:   · Ability to work effectively with employees and managers across different regions or functions.  · Adaptable approach to supporting different types of HR enquiries and stakeholders.  · Technologically confident with the ability to learn new HR systems and tools quickly.  Measures of Success:   · Accurate and timely processing of HR transactions.  · Effective and responsive handling of HR enquiries.  · High-quality and well-maintained HR records within HR systems.  · Positive feedback from employees and managers using HR Services.  · Contribution to continuous improvement of HR processes and service delivery. This position will be responsible for ensuring accurate and timely financials for MGI-Brazil as well as managing the contract accounting firm for Brazil operations and liaison with the commercial team in Brazil. In order to achieve success in this role the position requires the ability to collaborate effectively across all functions and levels, as well as across international boundaries, with finance teams in the US and Shenzhen, China. Reporting to the US Finance Director, the position is based in São Paulo, Brazil. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Financial Operation: Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, and general ledger activities. Support customer invoicing and sales tax calculation. Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions. Maintain and improve internal controls and financial procedures. Support financial processes and IT system improvements (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, internally designed Shared Service Platform) Month-end Closing and Reporting: Responsible for over-seeing the contract accounting team in Brazil. Prepare Month-end closing and ensure accurate and timely Finance Statements are submitted to HQ Reporting team. Arrange stock take and fixed assets take procedures. Tax Compliance and annual audit support: Ensure compliance with local and international accounting standards and regulatory requirements. Work with tax consultants to prepare and file tax returns, ensuring compliance with local tax regulations. Support group annual audit procedures (i.e. audit confirmations and PBC list) Cash Management: Monitor and manage the company's cash flow, ensuring sufficient liquidity for operations. Own the cash management function and liaison with treasury administrator in US. Budgeting and Forecasting: Participate in the annual budgeting process for MGI Brazil and Actual v Budget analysis. Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying variances and recommending corrective actions. Commercial Team Support: Build relationships with and support the Brazil Commercial team. Identify opportunities for cost reduction and efficiency improvements. QUALIFICATIONS At least 5 years of relevant accounting experience in a fast-paced, fluid, results-oriented, hands-on environment, including with teams that are geographically dispersed across international boundaries. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial regulations, and reporting standards. Experience with ERP and Financial IT systems (e.g., CRM, Oracle ERP, Concur, etc.) BS/BA degree in Accounting/Finance/Business. CPA a plus. Biotechnology/Medical Devices/Pharmaceutical industry experience and multinational experience; experience with import tax a plus. Proven experience in instrument sales or related industry is a plus. Knowledge of Portuguese and English is required. Chinese language a plus. Must have strong excel skills. BEHAVIORS, SKILLS, AND KNOWLEDGE Team-oriented with outstanding integrity, accuracy, and organizational skills. Ability to proactively identify and solve problems. Exhibits the highest degree of integrity and ethics, with the ability to work independently and with minimal supervision. Strong team player willing to be flexible and to tackle a variety of tasks and responsibilities. Ability to navigate and be successful in a highly matrixed, fast-paced environment. Results-oriented with excellent analytic, communication, and collaboration skills Ability to operate under different business models and complex business structures.

title: Hr services administrator - brazil
description:

Job Description Alkegen brings together two of the world’s leading specialty materials companies to create one new, innovation-driven leader focused on battery technologies, filtration media, and specialty insulation and sealing materials. Through global reach and breakthrough inventions, we are delivering products that enable the world to breathe easier, live greener, and go further than ever before. With over 60 manufacturing facilities with a global workforce of over 9,000 of the industry’s most experienced talent, including insulation and filtration experts, Alkegen is uniquely positioned to help customers impact the environment in meaningful ways. Alkegen offers a range of dynamic career opportunities with a global reach. From production operators to engineers, technicians to specialists, sales to leadership, we are always looking for top talent ready to bring their best. Come grow with us! Overview The HR Services Administrator role is a fantastic opportunity to build a strong foundation in HR and develop your skills within a supportive and collaborative team environment. Acting as the first point of contact for employees and managers, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality HR support across the organisation. You will gain hands-on experience across the full employee lifecycle, supporting a wide range of HR processes while ensuring accuracy, consistency, and a great employee experience. Working within the HR Services team, you will develop a solid understanding of HR systems, policies, and best practice, with plenty of opportunity to learn and grow. From time to time, you will also work directly with business stakeholders, building relationships and gaining a broader understanding of how HR supports the wider organisation. In addition, you will collaborate with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) and Centres of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Compensation & Benefits, Learning & Development, Payroll and HRIS, giving you valuable insight into how a modern HR function operates. Key Responsibilities: Employee Lifecycle Administration · Issue contracts and variations · Coordinate interviews and pre-employment checks · Support onboarding and offboarding · Process employee changes (role, pay, transfers, CBA progression) HR Systems and Records · Support employees and managers with HR system navigation and self-service processes within Workday. · Log and manage HR enquiries within the HR case management system. · Support Workday user access requests and provide basic troubleshooting support where required. · Maintain HR templates, policies and documentation within HR systems. HR Enquiries and Support · Act as the first point of contact for HR enquiries from employees and managers. · Respond to HR enquiries and provide guidance on HR policies, procedures and HR processes. · Identify the underlying issue through effective questioning and provide accurate and thorough responses. · Direct employees and managers to relevant HR resources, policies or self-service guidance. · Research solutions to HR enquiries and escalate more complex matters to the HR Services Advisor when appropriate. Reporting and Compliance · Run standard HR reports and provide basic HR data or analytics to HR teams, HR Business Partners or leadership when required. · Support HR audits and compliance activities. · Ensure HR records are maintained in accordance with company policies, data protection requirements and employment legislation. Collaboration and HR Service Delivery · Work closely with HR Services Advisors to ensure efficient resolution of HR queries and cases. · Partner with HR Business Partners and HR Centres of Excellence to support HR processes and activities. · Ensure HR activities are delivered in line with organisational policies and standards. · Adhere to company safety, integrity and code of conduct policies. Continuous Improvement · Support continuous improvement initiatives within HR Services. · Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, service delivery and system usage. · Contribute to maintaining efficient and consistent HR administration within the HR Services team. Skills and Experience: · Previous experience in an administrative, HR support or customer service role desirable. · Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail. · Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritise workload effectively in a fast-paced environment. · Strong communication skills and a professional approach when responding to HR enquiries. · Ability to ask effective questions to understand the nature of HR enquiries and identify appropriate solutions. · Demonstrates empathy, emotional intelligence and a strong customer service mindset when supporting employees and managers. · Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee information appropriately. · Comfortable working with HR systems and technology. Knowledge and Qualifications: · Experience working in an HR environment desirable. · Working knowledge of HR systems such as Workday desirable. · Basic understanding of HR policies, HR processes and employment law fundamentals. · Education in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related field Additional Requirements: · Ability to work effectively with employees and managers across different regions or functions. · Adaptable approach to supporting different types of HR enquiries and stakeholders. · Technologically confident with the ability to learn new HR systems and tools quickly. Measures of Success: · Accurate and timely processing of HR transactions. · Effective and responsive handling of HR enquiries. · High-quality and well-maintained HR records within HR systems. · Positive feedback from employees and managers using HR Services. · Contribution to continuous improvement of HR processes and service delivery. At Alkegen, we strive every day to help people – ALL PEOPLE – breathe easier, live greener and go further than ever before. We believe that diversity and inclusion is central to this mission and to our impact. Our diverse and inclusive culture drives our growth & innovation and we nurture it by actively embracing our differences and using our varied perspectives to solve the complex challenges facing our changing and diverse world. Employment selection and related decisions are made without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, nation of origin, religion, color, gender identity and expression, age, disability, education, opinions, culture, languages spoken, veteran’s status, or any other protected class.

About BGI BGI Group was founded in 1999 in China with the vision of using genomics for the benefit of mankind and has since become the largest genomics organization in the world. With over 10,000 employees, BGI operates in more than 100 countries, focusing on research and applications in healthcare, agriculture, conservation, and environmental fields. BGI has a proven track record of innovative, high-profile research, which has generated over 3,800 publications, with 430+ publications in top-tier journals such as Nature, Science and Cell. Additionally, in the field of R&D, BGI was ranked No.1 among corporations in the life science/biotechnology sector in the Asia-Pacific region and No.5 worldwide by Nature Index. About MGI MGI is one of the subsidiaries of BGI Group, it is committed to building core tools and technology to lead life science through intelligent innovation. Primeiro, nos apresentamos: Somos a Greystar, uma empresa com um modelo de negócio focado na gestão, desenvolvimento e investimento de apartamentos para aluguer totalmente equipados, com espaços comuns acolhedores e um serviço de administração profissional que é referência no mercado. Somos uma empresa que tem as pessoas no centro de tudo o que fazemos e trabalhamos com base nos nossos pilares e valores; Nossos pilares nos orientam para "o que fazemos" e nossos valores norteiam "como fazemos". Hoje estamos em processo de crescimento no mercado brasileiro e por isso procuramos pessoas apaixonadas, dispostas a contribuir no que for necessário para alcançarmos juntos o melhor progresso. Você pode ser nosso próximo " Gerente de Propriedades " O que é ou faz um Gerente Geral de Propriedades ? O Gerente Geral de Propriedade é uma função importante para nossas operações. É ele quem lidera toda a operação dentro do local ou prédio. Apoia, desenvolve e executa estratégias da empresa relacionadas à operação/gestão de um imóvel, orientando os integrantes da equipe, implementando e melhorando continuamente para que o imóvel atenda e supere as metas financeiras orçadas. Isto, a fim de alcançar um ótimo desempenho comercial e operacional. Estas podem ser suas funções: Liderar as equipes de atendimento ao cliente e manutenção. Preparação de relatórios financeiros para nossos investidores. Gestão de equipes, levando a promover a criação do melhor local para trabalhar. Elaboração e gestão de orçamentos. Gestão proativa dos índices de satisfação dos clientes: análise de informações, criação de planos, monitoramento. Planejamento de atividades para a comunidade. Gestão holística da manutenção predial. Revisa, analisa e interpreta dados de mercado para identificar tendências emergentes que podem impactar o desempenho da propriedade.  Para nós, a experiência na liderança de equipes comerciais e de atendimento ao cliente é muito importante. Na verdade, procuramos complementar-nos com experiências de outras áreas e organizações, onde o "know-how" pode ser transferível e a multitarefa e a priorização de atividades estão presentes. Pré-requisitos: Carreiras com foco em Hospitality. Experiência liderando equipes de trabalho (operações, serviços, etc...) Experiência desejável nas áreas: Imobiliário, Multifamily, Hotelaria, Administração, Gestão de Projetos, Empreendedorismo, etc... Inglês avançado. Utilização de ferramentas Office 365.  Se você está interessado, então o que está esperando?

This role sits at the intersection of  Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI  , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.  The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with  LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics  , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”  Key Responsibilities    Champion an  AI-first engineering culture  through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.   Define and measure impact using  DORA and SPACE metrics  , driving improvements across engineering workflows.   Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred). This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS). Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing ai agent builder em jaraguá do sul. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview:  As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM. title: Senior voip engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior voip engineer em diadema. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior business analyst (healthcare marketing) em itupeva. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses). The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.  The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.  Financial   ● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.  ● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.  ● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates  ● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.  ● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients  ● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients  ● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions  Operational   ● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.  ● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.  ● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.  ● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.  Experience and Skills   ● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.  ● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance  ● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.  ● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.  ● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus  ● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.  ● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Artificial intelligence engineer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Artificial intelligence engineer em camboriú. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Job Title:  AI Engineer Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week) Contract Duration:  Long Term  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri) Work Hours:  PST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries) Overview   We are seeking an experienced  AI Engineer  to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of  Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI  , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.  The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with  LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics  , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.” Key Responsibilities    Champion an  AI-first engineering culture  through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.   Define and measure impact using  DORA and SPACE metrics  , driving improvements across engineering workflows.   Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.    Preferred / Nice to Have    Experience contributing to an  AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence  .   Hands-on experience with:  LLM Agents  RAG pipelines  Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.) Lang Chain / Llama Index  Exposure to  AI Fin Ops  , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.   Knowledge of  AI governance and security  , including:   OWASP Top 10 for LLMs  Prompt injection risks  Model supply chain security  Responsible AI controls  Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Nova oportunidade para Marketing ai agent builder em guarapuava. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Role Overview:  As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Platform engineer / devops engineer
description:

Job Title:   Platform Engineer / Dev Ops Engineer   Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)  Contract Duration:  12+ months with extensions  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)  Work Hours:  EST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)  Overview   We’re hiring a hands-on  Platform / Dev Ops Engineer  to join a small, high-impact platform team. This is a “boots-on-the-ground” execution role  —not advisory—focused on building, operating, and improving the infrastructure and tooling that enables 100–150 engineers  to ship code efficiently and reliably.  You’ll work closely with a lean team (Principal + Senior Engineers) and play a critical role in  day-to-day platform operations, automation, and developer enablement  .  What You’ll Do   Operate and improve platform tools to support engineering teams (triaging tickets, resolving build issues, handling access/secrets/env setup)  Manage  Kubernetes environments  : deployments, Helm charts, namespaces, rollout troubleshooting   Support and enhance  CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab CI preferred; Jenkins/Git Hub Actions acceptable)   Maintain and improve  self-service workflows  , templates, and developer “golden paths”   Work with observability tools ( Prometheus, Alertmanager, Thanos, Open Telemetry  ) to monitor systems and improve signal quality   Assist with  service instrumentation  across logging, metrics, and tracing   Contribute to documentation: runbooks, onboarding guides, SOPs  Participate in  on-call rotation  and support incident response   Optimize infrastructure for  cost, performance, and reliability    Automate repetitive tasks using scripting (Python/Bash)    Must-Have Requirements   6+ years  in Platform Engineering / Dev Ops / SRE / Infrastructure roles   Strong  AWS experience  (IAM, EC2/EKS, S3, Cloud Watch, etc.)   Deep  Kubernetes expertise  :   Operating and maintaining clusters  Experience building Kubernetes environments  Hands-on  Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)    Python scripting (mandatory)  for automation and tooling   Experience owning and maintaining  CI/CD pipelines    Strong  Linux fundamentals    Solid understanding of  observability concepts  (metrics, logs, tracing)    Preferred Qualifications    Experience with  Git Lab CI    Exposure to  Open Telemetry    API integration or tooling development (Python/Go/Java)  Experience supporting  large engineering teams (100+ developers)    Familiarity with  security in CI/CD or infrastructure workflows    Multi-cloud exposure (Azure/GCP alongside AWS)  Background in  mid-size, modern engineering organizations     What We’re NOT Looking For   No Kubernetes experience ❌  Bash-only engineers (no Python) ❌  Pure consulting/advisory profiles ❌  Pure security-focused candidates ❌  Heavy enterprise/banking-only backgrounds ❌  ML/Data Science profiles ❌    Team Structure   1 Principal Engineer  1 Senior Engineer  1 Engineer (India)  You = 4th key team member

title: Senior voip engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior voip engineer em boituva. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the role  We are hiring a  Senior Vo IP Engineer  to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  This role sits at the intersection of  telecom, networking, and software engineering  , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.  This is a  developer role  — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.  What you'll do  Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.  Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.  Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.  Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.  Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.  Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability.    What we're looking for:  Required   5+ years as a developer  building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.  Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack:     A B2 BUA / media server:  Asterisk or Free SWITCH   A SIP proxy / routing layer:  Kamailio or Open SIPS   Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.  Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.  Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.  Advanced English proficiency  (written and spoken).   Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.    Strong plus    Python  for automation, tooling, or service development.   SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).  Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).  Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).  Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).  Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.  Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.    Why this role   Fully remote with a flexible working model.  Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.  High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.  Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.  Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

Experience and Skills   ● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.  ● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance  ● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.  ● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.  ● Knowledge of ERP systems, Net Suite a plus  ● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.  ● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

description:

Job Title:  AI Engineer  Position Type:  Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)  Contract Duration:  Long Term  Work Schedule:  8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)  Work Hours:  PST  Location:  100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)  Overview   We are seeking an experienced  AI Engineer  to drive AI-first engineering practices and enable developer productivity at scale. This role sits at the intersection of  Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, and Applied AI  , focused on integrating AI-assisted tooling, LLM workflows, and automation into the software development lifecycle.  The ideal candidate will bring hands-on experience with  LLM APIs, AI developer tooling, Python automation, cloud infrastructure, and developer productivity metrics  , while helping shape internal AI governance, adoption frameworks, and scalable engineering “golden paths.”  Key Responsibilities    Champion an  AI-first engineering culture  through reusable playbooks, golden-path templates, and best practices that improve developer productivity.   Define and measure impact using  DORA and SPACE metrics  , driving improvements across engineering workflows.   Build reusable patterns for:  AI-assisted code generation  Pull request automation  Test generation  Debugging workflows  Developer self-service enablement  Evaluate, prototype, and lead  POCs for AI tools  , providing recommendations based on ROI, usability, technical merit, and stakeholder feedback.   Manage AI usage governance, including:  Token budgeting and cost controls  Usage monitoring and reporting  PII redaction guardrails  Audit logging and responsible AI practices  Develop lightweight AWS-based infrastructure supporting  LLM pipelines  , APIs, and AI integrations.   Integrate AI tooling into  Git Lab CI/CD, Git Ops workflows, and developer platforms  .   Instrument AI workflows with observability metrics and usage signals to support adoption and optimization.  Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive AI enablement initiatives.    Required Qualifications   8+ years of experience in  Platform Engineering, Dev Ops, Developer Experience  , or related engineering roles.   Strong hands-on experience with  LLM APIs and AI-assisted developer tooling  in production or enterprise settings.   Strong Python development skills for automation and AI workflow integrations.  Experience evaluating, procuring, or governing  AI/Saa S tools  , including vendor assessments, licensing, and cost management.   Practical daily usage of tools such as  Git Hub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, Chat GPT  , or similar.   Experience designing scalable developer workflows, internal platforms, or self-service engineering capabilities.  Strong AWS experience, ideally including:  Bedrock  API Gateway  Managed AI/Cloud Services  Experience with  Terraform, Helm, Git Ops, and CI/CD pipelines  (Git Lab preferred).   Strong observability mindset with experience defining meaningful metrics and instrumentation.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.    Preferred / Nice to Have    Experience contributing to an  AI Enablement function, Developer Experience program, or Center of Excellence  .   Hands-on experience with:  LLM Agents  RAG pipelines  Vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Open Search, etc.)  Lang Chain / Llama Index  Exposure to  AI Fin Ops  , usage reporting, and cost attribution models.   Knowledge of  AI governance and security  , including:   OWASP Top 10 for LLMs  Prompt injection risks  Model supply chain security  Responsible AI controls  Financial services or insurance domain experience is a plus.

title: Executivo de contas
description:
Confira a vaga para Executivo de contas em bauru. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Estamos contratando: Account Executive | SIGGA Technologies  Você já atuou com manutenção industrial, gestão de ativos ou soluções SAP (especialmente SAP PM)? Então essa oportunidade pode ser para você.  Na SIGGA, buscamos um(a) Account Executive com forte perfil consultivo, capaz de conectar tecnologia ao negócio e gerar valor real para nossos clientes. Mais do que vender, queremos alguém que entenda a dor do cliente — especialmente em ambientes industriais — e saiba traduzir isso em soluções estratégicas.  Quem somos? Com presença na América Latina, América do Norte, Europa e Ásia, a SIGGA está inserida nas rotinas industriais das maiores empresas do mundo. Somos movidos por inovação e pela Indústria 4.0, ajudando nossos clientes a aumentarem eficiência, produtividade e confiabilidade na gestão de ativos com SAP.  Por que essa experiência é importante? title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Confira a vaga para Marketing ai agent builder em nova odessa. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:  As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Marketing ai agent builder
description:
Empresa está contratando Marketing ai agent builder em campo bom. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Role Overview:  As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our \"agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a \"Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.   Core Responsibilities:   • Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.  • Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.  • Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to \"read\" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.  • Performance & Guardrails: Establish \"human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.  • System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including Hub Spot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.   Qualifications & Skills:   • Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market Saa S revenue engine.  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude Co Work, Code X) • Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., Lang Graph, Crew AI).  • Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex \"reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.  • Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.  • Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2 B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Gtm builder
description:

You are comfortable vibe-coding, shipping fast, and learning new AI tooling weekly. You’ve built side projects, internal tools, or production systems using LLMs, agents, or automation frameworks. You think in systems, not scripts. You’ll be responsible for building A...  You know that the leverage of a single great AI builder today is 10–100x a traditional engineer. Spot, internal databases, enrichment platforms, and product systems  • Automate workflows that previously required human operational effort  • Build scraping, parsing, and AI extraction systems to convert unstructured web data into structured intelligence  • Rapidly prototype, test, and deploy new AI capabilities as new models and tools become available  • Continuously improve agents to make external systems  • Ability to work with structured and unstructured data  • Experience with automation tools like N8 N, Make, Zapier, or similar  • Comfort working with web scraping, enrichment projects outside of work  • Bonus: You use AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow
